### Managerial Problem
Determine which digital campaigns and channels are producing the strongest engagement and traffic quality so marketing resources can be allocated more effectively.

### Business Impact
Supports stronger campaign planning by identifying which channels are most effective for reaching audiences, improving engagement, and reducing inefficient media spend.
